name: ml-solidarity-contribution
description: Mali Contribution spéciale de Solidarité, enacted 2025 source baseline held for 2026 verification: prepare a monthly turnover-based CSS working paper for an enterprise subject to industrial and commercial profits tax or corporate income tax. Use this Guide for the separate solidarity contribution, the tax-exclusive turnover base, loss-making businesses, the deduction of CSS paid, monthly reporting and the distinct late-declaration and incorrect-declaration penalty branches. It uses the enacted 2025 ordinance and ratification law rather than a proposed finance bill. It includes two executable cases. Current form boxes, authenticated filing steps, exemption conventions and complex VAT tax points remain outside this limited draft; no accountant has attested to it.
